text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear paragraph breaks with transitions like \"To begin with\" and \"Finally\"","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is more clearly structured into parts and uses signposting to guide the reader through its points."},{"evidence":"repeated sentence frames such as \"My talent is...\" and \"My skill is...\"","quality":"controlled development","description":"The essay sustains a single focus and develops ideas in a more orderly, easy-to-follow way."},{"evidence":"more complete sentences in the introduction and conclusion","quality":"sentence completeness","description":"The writing shows better control of sentence boundaries and is easier to read without running together."},{"evidence":"phrases like \"I enjoy drawing because I can draw what I'm feeling\"","quality":"clarity of expression","description":"The essay communicates ideas more directly and with less confusion than the other essay."},{"evidence":"fewer run-on stretches than the long uninterrupted paragraph in Essay B","quality":"sentence control","description":"The essay shows better control over how ideas are divided into sentences."}]}
